items.title: American Airlines Revenue Reset Gains Traction Despite Fuel Risks
items.summary: American Airlines' corporate recovery, premium growth and network gains are improving revenue quality, but fuel, labor and debt pressures cloud the outlook.

items.title: United Airlines Insider Sheds 13,794 Shares for $1.6 Million, According to Latest SEC Filing
items.summary: Most of the disposition was non-discretionary, tied to tax withholding on vested restricted stock units. The executive retains 222,955 shares worth roughly $27.6 million.

items.title: The Strategic Buyers That Could Scoop Up Distressed eVTOL Darling Archer Aviation
items.summary: Archer Aviation has gone from retail darling to distressed asset trading near multi-year lows, and a short list of corporate giants already has the motive, money, and strategic logic to make a move before someone else does.

items.title: Delta's Profits vs. GE's Premiums: Is the Market Mispricing These 2 Stocks?
items.summary: One stock is richly valued as the market assumes long-term growth driven by end demand from one of the same airlines that is lowly valued.

items.title: Archer Aviation vs. Redwire: Which Aerospace Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Archer trades at a 1,770x premium valuation despite near-zero revenue, while Redwire generates $335M in annual sales but faces shareholder dilution risks.

items.title: Archer Aviation vs. QuantumScape: Which EV Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Both companies are pre-revenue or early-revenue stage with massive losses, but their paths to commercialization, and risk profiles, diverge sharply.

items.title: Archer Aviation vs. Rivian Automotive: Which EV Vehicle Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Both companies are burning cash heavily, but their paths to profitability, and risk profiles, diverge sharply.

items.title: JetBlue Advances 9% on Earnings Beat and 2028 Profit Target, Lifting Delta, United, and Southwest
items.summary: JetBlue just handed investors a reason to rethink the entire airline sector, but the same earnings report that sent shares soaring also revealed a widening loss that bulls are choosing to ignore.
